# CardDAV saved-login selection suppresses OAuth before password challenge handling

CardDAV checks saved logins for the server origin and configured username before creating OAuth. A match stores _oAuth = null, so later requests keep the password path. The presence test caches that choice; it does not prove the password works. CardDAVUtils supplies the saved password when the server challenges and attaches a Bearer header only for a non-null OAuth object. New-account authentication-choice UI and automatic OAuth fallback after a bad saved password are not established by these source ranges. No authentication or test ran.

Scope: CardDAV request authentication selection.
